meta.title: Gianluca Laydner · Fullstack e-commerce developer
meta.description: Developer specializing in e-commerce with Oracle Commerce Cloud. Thirteen online stores across Brazil, Uruguay and Chile, plus two products of my own, both live.

hero.headline: I build the online stores Latin America buys from
hero.lede: Developer specializing in e-commerce with Oracle Commerce Cloud. Thirteen online stores live, three countries, since 2022.

shelf.title: Thirteen online stores, live
shelf.lede: Real people buy from these every day. None is a prototype, none is an exercise.

career.title: Three companies, one specialty
career.lede: I joined as an intern and left as a mid-level developer at the same firm, then took that specialty to two more. The clients changed, the work did not.

products.title: Two products I built and run
products.lede: After hours I don't build portfolio exercises, I ship products. Concept, code, infrastructure, domain and support. Both are live right now.

evermemo.tagline: A digital gift behind a QR code
evermemo.body: Photos, music and a message become a page that exists for one person only. They point their camera at a printed QR code and the memory opens. There are templates for every occasion, paid plans and a full checkout flow.

futeboldle.body: A secret player to guess every day, comparing five attributes until you get it. Two daily modes, World Cup and Brasileirão Série A, plus Escalação Retrô, which draws a club and a year and dares you to rebuild the squad. Line-ups come from Wikipedia and Wikidata, curated by hand.

contact.title: Let's talk
contact.lede: I'm open to roles and projects, in Brazil or abroad.
